mapper.select: SELECT poi.sku_code AS skuCode, po.currency_code AS currency, SUM(poi.quantity) AS qty, SUM(poi.quantity * poi.unit_price) AS amount FROM wms_purchase_order po INNER JOIN wms_purchase_order_item poi ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id WHERE po.deleted = 0 AND po.order_status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'IN_PRODUCTION', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY poi.sku_code, po.currency_code

SELECT po.id AS purchaseOrderId, po.order_no AS orderNo, po.supplier_id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, po.currency_code AS currency, po.total_amount AS totalAmount, po.prepay_amount AS prepayAmount, po.prepay_status AS prepayStatus, po.balance_status AS balanceStatus, po.prepay_time AS prepayTime, po.balance_pay_time AS balancePayTime, po.order_status AS orderStatus FROM wms_purchase_order po LEFT JOIN supplier s ON s.id = po.supplier_id WHERE po.deleted = 0 AND (po.order_status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'IN_PRODUCTION', 'COMPLETED') OR po.prepay_status = 1 OR po.balance_status = 1)

SELECT so.id AS shippingOrderId, so.shipping_no AS shippingNo, so.provider_id AS providerId, so.total_amount AS orderTotalUsd, so.total_amount_cny AS orderTotalCny, soi.sku_code AS skuCode, soi.quantity AS quantity FROM wms_shipping_order so INNER JOIN wms_shipping_order_item soi ON soi.shipping_order_id = so.id WHERE so.deleted = 0 AND so.shipping_status <> 'PENDING'

SELECT so.id AS shippingOrderId, so.shipping_no AS shippingNo, so.provider_id AS providerId, lp.provider_name AS providerName, so.total_amount AS totalAmount, so.total_amount_cny AS totalAmountCny, so.payment_status AS paymentStatus, so.shipping_status AS shippingStatus FROM wms_shipping_order so LEFT JOIN wms_logistics_provider lp ON lp.id = so.provider_id WHERE so.deleted = 0
